name: Can you replace an existing bathtub with a walk-in shower?

mainEntity.name: Can you replace an existing bathtub with a walk-in shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, converting an existing bathtub into a walk-in shower is one of the most common bathroom remodeling projects. A standard tub footprint of 60 by 30 inches provides sufficient space for a comfortable, modern walk-in shower. During this conversion, the contractor removes the old tub surround, evaluates the underlying plumbing, and relocates the drain line, as shower drains require a larger diameter pipe than tub drains to manage water flow properly. New water-resistant wallboard or drywall repairs prepare the enclosure before waterproofing, custom tile installation, and fixture mounting take place.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a standard bathtub alcove can be converted into a walk-in shower, which typically involves updating the drain size, repairing wallboard, and adding custom tile.
